load_and_preprocess_data: load and preprocess computational, experimental, and XRD data files for CO2R or HER electrocatalysis analysis
get_and_apply_xrf_mapping: apply XRF composition mapping from an XRF dataframe onto experimental data and filter nulls
get_distance_between_formulas: compute the euclidean distance between two chemical composition strings like Pt-0.5-Pd-0.5
get_production_rate: convert a faradaic efficiency percentage and current density into a production rate in mol per cm2 per second
add_cv_categories: add leave-one-out and leave-one-composition-out cross-validation category columns to a pandas dataframe
